supersedes: S-1: integer kobo, currency NGN, over the wire and in storage; prices only from the price book

fields.name: at
supersedes: S-22: every epoch-ms `at` becomes createdAt/updatedAt ISO-8601 UTC strings set by the server; calendar dates are YYYY-MM-DD strings (date-only canon)

fields.name: content.ending.id
supersedes: S-2: server-issued UUIDv7 ids

fields.name: content.opening.id
supersedes: S-2: server-issued UUIDv7 ids

fields.name: id
supersedes: S-2: server-issued UUIDv7 ids

fields.name: makerNote.wishId
supersedes: S-2: server-issued UUIDv7 ids

fields.name: price
supersedes: S-1: integer kobo, currency NGN, over the wire and in storage; prices only from the price book

fields.name: style name via styleOf(w.style).name (catalog lookup, local)
w.photos[0] used as tile image; fallback literal /img/aisha-1.webp when empty
wishId
supersedes: S-2: server-issued UUIDv7 ids

sources.via: read:Person (as used here: id, name) (route DEC-112)

body.name: style
body.type: string (default styleFor, or ?style= when it fits)

body.name: content.cover.more
body.type: string[] (written by Names component; entries may be blank until trimmed in ready check)

body.name: content.details
body.type: array: when details already has entries, first row {label:'The day', value: longDay(date)} replacing any earlier 'The day' row; else left untouched

body.name: content.on
body.type: ChapterType[] set to [] if unset so the choice is recorded

body.name: content.studio
body.type: string (only for teams/photographers: existing studio or account.pro.business or '')

body.name: content.voices.items
body.type: {name:string (default 'A friend'),text:string,role?:string}[] (rows with no text dropped), max 12

body.name: opensAt
body.type: string ISO-8601 from local date+time via new Date(`${day}T${time}:00`).toISOString() (browser's own time zone, no zone sent)

body.name: passcode
body.type: string, at least 4 chars, max 64 (write only: stored hashed, never returned; null clears it)

body.name: timeZone
body.type: string (optional; an IANA zone name such as Africa/Lagos)

body.name: version
body.type: integer (the version the page last read; the write is refused 409 when it is older)

response.note: 200 {version, updatedAt} (DEC-170)

body.name: files
body.type: image/* File[] (multiple, up to room = most - current count)

body.name: result
body.type: each shrunk client-side to <=720px JPEG data URL at quality 0.6 and appended to wish.photos

response.note: {payment, item}: payment null when the Pass covers the keep; item is the wish, status live, endsAt = max(endsAt, now)+days for live; now+days for resting (DEC-139)
the draft as a Signature wish; one Pass upgrade drawn (DEC-176)

body.name: status
body.type: before(w): 'draft' if no no; 'sealed' if no openedAt; 'resting' if endsAt<=now else 'live'

body.name: adds
body.type: string[] extra names e.g. 'A premium style','Five more photos' (derived, not sent today)

body.name: content
body.type: WishContent with note.from and finale.sign finalised (noteFrom, finaleOf)

body.name: openNow
body.type: boolean (optional; true opens the wish as soon as it is paid)

body.name: usePass
body.type: boolean (optional; true draws one wish from the Pass in place of a ticket payment)

body.name: version
body.type: integer (the version the page last read)

response.note: {payment, item}: item is the wish, sealed once the verified payment fulfils it (DEC-139)

auth.note: queue job or port; no HTTP route

sharedShapes.PaginatedList<T>: { items: T[], nextCursor: string | null } with ?cursor=&limit= (conventions.md)
